overview: The Common Facility Centre (CFC) under the MSE-CDP scheme aims to support the sustainability and growth of Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) by addressing common issues such as technology, skills, quality, and market access. It focuses on creating or upgrading infrastructural facilities in industrial areas/clusters, setting up Common Facility Centres for testing, training, raw material depot, effluent treatment, and complementing production processes, and promoting green and sustainable manufacturing technology for clusters.
objectives: To support the sustainability and growth of MSEs by addressing common issues such as improvement of technology, skills & quality, market access, etc.
To create/upgrade infrastructural facilities in the new/existing Industrial Areas/Clusters of MSEs.
To set up Common Facility Centres (for testing, training, raw material depot, effluent treatment, complementing production processes, etc).
Promotion of green & sustainable manufacturing technology for the clusters.
Creation of Common Facility Centers including Plug & Play Facilities.
Support for Infrastructure Development Projects including Flatted Factory Complexes.
eligibility: Existing Entrepreneurs [in form of a Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs)].
benefits: GoI Assistance: up to 80% of the maximum Project cost of Rs. 30 crores. Creation of, “Tangible Assets” such as Common Production / Processing Centre, Design Centers, Testing Facilities including Plug & Play Facilities.
financial_support: GoI Assistance: up to 80% of the maximum Project cost of Rs. 30 crores. The scheme provides financial assistance for setting up Common Facility Centres including Plug & Play Facilities, and support for Infrastructure Development Projects including Flatted Factory Complexes.
grant_amount_per_entity: up to 80% of the maximum Project cost of Rs. 30 crores
application_process: 1. Apply through the websites of MSME-DFOs, MSME-TC and other Implementing Agencies under MSE-CDP scheme. 2. The scheme link is https://cluster.dcmsme.gov.in
implementing_agency: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
